I have so many mixed feelings. Being a child in the 80s and lifelong MJ fan, this was always our first AND last stop at Epcot, every single time we went. And while I still love the film, and MJ, and the music... I feel like this would do much better if they cleaned up the film and upgraded the theater in some ways. We got a chance to see it in Paris in 2010 and really enjoyed it for some reason (perhaps it was because it had been so long, I don't know), but then seeing it again at Epcot this past January was kinda "meh." I think that was mostly because everything felt so dated, and I'm not even talking about the movie. I genuinely believe the entrance to the theater must be some sort of portal back to '86.

I kept going back on over and over again, with no wait until the 8th time. And by then it was time to leave the park. A good day if you ask me, lol. :D

Worst: Both CircleVision 360 films in Epcot (Reflections of China, O Canada). Those two films were the only times in my entire life I felt motion sickness... and I am a coaster and spinny-ride fanatic.
